qualification_verdict: Not assigned by this correlation helper; assess capture summary and all risks separately.
metric_definition: HOST synthetic image generation completion to HOST complete-frame receipt, matched by coherent optical ID; includes image hold age, rendering, presentation, acquisition and transport. Not HDMI wire latency and not board/host clock synchronization.

optical_id_gaps.interpretation: Observed ID gaps alone do not identify hardware/network drops; source holding and intentional sampling apply.

transport_frame_id_gaps.interpretation: Observed ID gaps alone do not identify hardware/network drops; source holding and intentional sampling apply.

limits: Periodic metadata samples can miss transitions between samples; XR24 samples do not prove continuous direct scanout.
A source pre-swap event or swap return is not measured HDMI presentation time.
The board monotonic timestamp is not subtracted from the host monotonic clock.
Host optical ID gaps can include intentional sampling and are not attributed to network or hardware loss.
Live file snapshots may cover different end times; hashes identify only the bytes read.

capture_summary.litex_snapshot_association: Sequential non-atomic snapshots; no per-frame association
capture_summary.startup_invalid_scope: Unselected input before capture enable only when disabled baseline proof passes

operator_closeout.source_process: closed after post-qualification mode switch; placement guard reported drawable2560x1440 instead of640x480, not a normal successful renderer run exit
operator_closeout.scanout_process: closed by operator SIGINT after qualification and post-window mode switch
operator_closeout.post_window_scope: Later59.940Hz/XR30 observations are excluded from the completed600-second capture receipt window.
